en: The national flower, sampaguita, undergoes photosynthesis year-round, and its white petals release a sweet scent observable in many Philippine gardens.
The Ifugao carved Banaue Rice Terraces into mountains, creating observable stepped ponds that use gravity to distribute irrigation water for rice.
Scientist Ramon Barba discovered that applying potassium nitrate to mango trees triggers observable hormonal changes that force them to bloom out of season.
The Philippine Eagle, our national bird, uses observable keen binocular vision to hunt monkeys high in the primary forests of Mindanao.
During the Pahiyas Festival, residents display colorful kiping, which is made from observable rice starch dyed with natural plant extracts.
The narra, our national tree, undergoes secondary growth observable as tree rings, producing the hard, reddish-brown wood used in local furniture.
Marine scientist Angel Alcala established coral sanctuaries where the observable biological process of coral skeleton building rebuilds habitats for local fish.
Mayon Volcano in Albay is an observable stratovolcano formed by layers of solidified lava and ash, which heavily influences local agriculture.
The carabao, our national animal, has observable wide, splayed hooves that distribute its weight to prevent sinking in muddy, waterlogged rice paddies.
T'boli weavers extract abaca fibers through observable mechanical scraping of the native banana plant's stalk to weave the traditional T'nalak cloth.
Emilio Aguinaldo proclaimed independence under a tamarind tree, an observable leguminous plant that fixes atmospheric nitrogen into its local soil.
The Panagbenga Festival celebrates the observable light-dependent blooming of seasonal flowers, which respond to the cool, high-altitude climate of Baguio.
